Privacy.label: Legal document
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.metaDescription: How North Sun s.r.o. processes personal data — controller, purpose, scope, data subject rights under the GDPR.
Privacy.intro: North Sun s.r.o. (Company No. 17279976, registered at Sokolská 137, 330 27 Vejprnice, Czech Republic) respects the privacy of website visitors and clients. This document explains how we process personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). Contact: {email}.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body:
Controller: North Sun s.r.o.
Company No. 17279976, VAT ID CZ17279976
Registered office: Sokolská 137, 330 27 Vejprnice, Czech Republic
Contact: {email}

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
sections.body: When you submit the contact form, we process: your full name, email address, phone number (optional), project type and the message you send. For anti-spam and abuse protection we also technically store your IP address and browser information (User-Agent).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: We process the form data to respond to your enquiry and any subsequent communication. The legal basis is taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in protection against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: 4. Retention period
sections.body: Personal data from the contact form is retained for 24 months from submission, or for the duration of the business relationship and any applicable statutory limitation periods. After this period the data is anonymised or erased.

sections.heading: 5. Third-party recipients
sections.body: We do not share your data with third parties outside our company except for our processors (Vercel Inc. — website hosting, Upstash Inc. — database for storing messages, and our email service provider for notification delivery). We have Data Processing Agreements with all processors as required by Art. 28 GDPR.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and analytics
sections.body: Essential cookies are always used (site functionality, language preference). Analytics cookies (Vercel Analytics — anonymised traffic statistics) are used only with your consent, which you can grant or refuse in the cookie banner on your first visit. You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing cookies in your browser.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights under the GDPR
sections.body:
You have the right to:
– request access to your personal data (Art. 15),
– request correction of inaccurate data (Art. 16),
– request erasure (Art. 17),
– request restriction of processing (Art. 18),
– data portability (Art. 20),
– object to processing (Art. 21),
– lodge a complaint with the Czech Data Protection Authority (uoou.cz).

To exercise your rights, contact us at {email}.

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorised access or disclosure. All communication with the site is encrypted (HTTPS).

About.label: About NorthSun
About.title: EPC with a Nordic accent
About.lead: A Czech-Swedish-Norwegian firm focused on solar.
About.body: Unlike typical installation contractors, we produce our own technical documentation and structural calculations in-house. We work in PV syst and PV sol, and we run every project from the first feasibility study through to handover. Our team speaks eight languages and trains every year at Intersolar in Munich.

Services.title:

engineering team
Services.lead:
From family homes to utility-scale parks.
Always with in-house documentation and structural design.

Why.label: Why NorthSun
Why.title: An engineering firm, not a crew with ladders
Why.lead: Four reasons clients hire us for projects others turn down.

items.title: Engineering-led EPC
items.description: In-house technical documentation, structural calculations and PV syst simulations. We don't outsource the decisions that matter.

items.title: International experience
items.description: References in Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Norway, Belgium and Croatia. We work where the project makes sense, regardless of borders.

items.title: Certified quality
items.description: We hold a PanelClaw certification for the successful installation of their mounting systems. Quality on paper, not just in pitch decks.

items.title: Multilingual team
items.description: We communicate in eight languages and train every year at Intersolar in Munich. We follow the technology where it's made.

References.label: Our work
References.title: Premium projects across Europe
References.lead:
Own deliveries and partner projects across Europe.
Every project carries our own engineering documentation and structural design.

items.title: 1 MW Solar Installation, Rudshøgda
items.description: We completed a 1 MW installation in Rudshøgda, Norway. The project went according to plan, smoothly and with professional quality. We used the PanelClaw Europe (Enstall Group) mounting system and Longi 645 W panels. DC measurement was completed successfully with the Metrel MI3114PS.
items.alt: 1 MW solar installation in Rudshøgda, Norway
